content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

How are group revenue and EBITDA tracking year to date versus last year?

content.statement:
WITH __pnl AS (
  SELECT
    fiscal_year,
    group_line,
    year_month,
    amount_inr
  FROM WIPRO_FINANCE_360_APP.APP_DATA.V_AGENT_PNL
)
SELECT
  fiscal_year,
  SUM(IFF(group_line = 'REVENUE', amount_inr, 0)) AS revenue_inr,
  SUM(IFF(group_line = 'REVENUE', amount_inr, 0)) - SUM(IFF(group_line = 'COGS', amount_inr, 0)) - SUM(IFF(group_line = 'OPEX', amount_inr, 0)) AS ebitda_inr,
  IFF(
    SUM(IFF(group_line = 'REVENUE', amount_inr, 0)) = 0
    OR SUM(IFF(group_line = 'REVENUE', amount_inr, 0)) IS NULL,
    0,
    (
      SUM(IFF(group_line = 'REVENUE', amount_inr, 0)) - SUM(IFF(group_line = 'COGS', amount_inr, 0)) - SUM(IFF(group_line = 'OPEX', amount_inr, 0))
    ) / NULLIF(SUM(IFF(group_line = 'REVENUE', amount_inr, 0)), 0)
  ) * 100 AS ebitda_margin_pct
FROM __pnl
WHERE
  fiscal_year IN (2025, 2026) AND MONTH(year_month) <= 7
GROUP BY
  fiscal_year
ORDER BY
  fiscal_year
 -- Generated by Cortex Analyst (request_id: 272f35e6-afab-4029-9134-43e23b99e12d)
;
